name: VPython
category: A9. Adjacent resources mentioned during discovery
role: Python 3D for teaching; browser-rendered scenes, no documented headless export
summary: Python package where short scripts create 3D objects whose scene is rendered by a browser or notebook widget. Driven by Python; output is an interactive scene in a window, with no documented image or video export from the command line. Its strength is physics-teaching brevity, not production rendering.
use_when: Reproducing an existing VPython physics demo as a screen capture
avoid_when: Python-scripted frames: Blender via bpy or Manim for maths animation

assessment.rationale: Latest PyPI 7.6.5 (March 2024); the README says a CLI launch opens a browser window and describes no headless or export route. Blender, Manim and Three.js cover Python-driven or browser 3D with real output paths.

notes: 2026-10-26: headless rendering not documented; not tried. Repo issue and PR counts suggest light activity.
